query.description: Natural language description of what you're looking for. Be specific about the task, context, or situation you want to find similar examples for.

filters.description: Optional filters to narrow the search. All filters are optional and can be combined.

domain.description: Filter by domain (e.g., 'dsf' for Deep Sci-Fi)

tags.description: Filter by tags (matches any tag in list)

include_failures.description: Whether to include failed experiences as anti-patterns. Default: false. Set to true to learn what to avoid.

limit.description: Maximum number of examples to return per category (successes and failures). Default: 5.
